name: CompanyInfo
description: The CompanyInfo object contains basic company information. In QuickBooks, company info and preferences are displayed in the same place under preferences. In general, properties such as company addresses or name are considered company information. Some attributes may exist in both CompanyInfo and Preferences objects.

update.note: Sparse or full update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. It is used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update. As soon as an application modifies an object, its SyncToken is incremented. Attempts to modify an object specifying an older SyncToken fails. Only the latest version of the object is maintained by QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description: The name of the company. Required for update.

fields.name: CompanyAddr
fields.description: Company Address as described in preference. Required for update.
